## Miner_3 Research Cycle Summary (2026-07-16)

### Explored Factors
Deep-validated the **short-term reversal family** (1/2/3/5-day lookbacks, raw and volatility-scaled) and the **close-location-value (CLV) family** (1d and 5d range position) across the full 15-instrument cross-asset universe (1381 common dates, 2020-01-06..2026-07-15, ~20.7k obs). Motivation: cross-asset indices/commodities/crypto exhibit short-horizon mean reversion, particularly after risk-off spikes.

### Validation Results (IC at 1-day horizon; gate: |IC|≥0.0070, |ICIR|≥0.0840)
| Candidate | IC | ICIR | Hit | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| rev_1d | +0.0559 | +0.161 | 0.563 | ✅ PASS |
| rev_2d | +0.0523 | +0.150 | 0.560 | ✅ PASS (redundant w/ rev_1d, ρ=0.64) |
| rev_3d | +0.0400 | +0.114 | 0.544 | ✅ PASS (ρ=0.95 w/ rev_3d_vol) |
| rev_5d | +0.0313 | +0.088 | 0.526 | marginal — 2026 IC = −0.042 |
| rev_3d_vol | +0.0326 | +0.101 | 0.551 | ✅ PASS (ρ=0.95 w/ rev_3d) |
| clv_1d | −0.0377 | −0.132 | 0.441 | ✅ PASS (abs) |
| clv_5d | −0.0398 | −0.123 | 0.443 | ✅ PASS (abs) |

Robustness checks: rev_1d positive in **all 6 years** (2021:+0.057 … 2026:+0.035), stronger in high-VIX regimes (IC +0.070/ICIR 0.198), no time drift (early +0.050 vs late +0.062), monotonic decay to ~0 by h20. clv_5d negative in all years, decays by h10, complementary to rev_1d (pooled ρ = −0.638).

### Persistence Actions
- **`factors/miner3_20260716_rev_1d.json`** — status EFFECTIVE (IC +0.0559, ICIR +0.161, cov 0.999, turn 0.344, max_abs_lib_corr 0.000)
- **`factors/miner3_20260716_clv_5d.json`** — status EFFECTIVE (IC −0.0398, ICIR −0.123, cov 0.997, turn 0.340, max_abs_lib_corr 0.000; sign convention documented: trade −CLV)

Both written, read back, and verified as valid JSON with all required fields. Redundant candidates (rev_2d/rev_3d/rev_3d_vol, clv_1d) intentionally not persisted to keep pairwise library correlation low.

### Current Effective Factors
1. **rev_1d** (1-day reversal) — strongest and most stable; drives US equity/crypto/rates; weaker on China assets.
2. **clv_5d** (5-day range-position reversal) — distinct family, negative-IC signal, high-VIX sensitive.

### Plans
- VIX-conditional weighting of reversal exposure (signal is ~2x stronger in high-VIX regimes).
- Conditional reversal blend: rev_1d × (high-volume day) to reduce noise, plus decay-aware holding (rebalance ~5 days vs 10 to capture h1–h5 IC).
- Re-validate both factors quarterly for drift (e.g., rev_5d's 2026 sign flip is a warning flag).
